passages.title: A Family Trip to the Mountains
passages.text: Last month, my family and I went (1) ........ a wonderful trip to the Rocky Mountains. We had been planning this holiday (2) ........ a very long time, so we were all extremely excited. We stayed in a small wooden cabin (3) ........ was located near a beautiful blue lake. Every morning, we woke up early to go hiking. The weather was perfect, although it was much colder (4) ........ we had expected. One afternoon, while we (5) ........ walking through the forest, we saw a family of deer. It was amazing! My father took a lot of photos of them. We spent five days there, and it was definitely one of (6) ........ best holidays of my life. I hope we can return next year.

questions.question: Fill in gap (1) with one word.
questions.explanation: The preposition 'on' is used in the expression 'to go on a trip'.

questions.question: Fill in gap (2) with one word.
questions.explanation: The preposition 'for' is used to show the duration of an action (for a very long time).

questions.question: Fill in gap (3) with one word.
questions.explanation: The relative pronoun 'which' (or 'that') is used to refer to things (in this case, 'a small wooden cabin').

questions.question: Fill in gap (4) with one word.
questions.explanation: The word 'than' is used to introduce the second element in a comparison after a comparative adjective like 'colder'.

questions.question: Fill in gap (5) with one word.
questions.explanation: The past continuous tense is formed with 'was/were' + verb-ing. Since the subject is 'we', the correct form is 'were'.

questions.question: Fill in gap (6) with one word.
questions.explanation: The definite article 'the' is required before the superlative adjective 'best'.
